column1: # Alex marks Mogall Forest; Lamakan's heat and ash-thick air remain dangerous.

column3: The broken sign reads:{page_break}North: Fuchin Temple\nSouth: Mogall Prairie...{end_wait}
Agh... The sand is hot\nnow, and it's still\nsweltering.{end_wait}
Every step sinks in loose\nsand. This desert burns\nwithout a flame.{end_wait}
I can't stop sweating,\nand I can't catch my\nbreath. The air is thick.{end_wait}
The air is thick with ash,\nbut there's no smoke\nanywhere.{end_wait}
I can't keep my cool\nwhen the ground burns\nunder me.{end_wait}
Ew... My clothes are\ncaked in dust and sweat!\nThis is gross!{end_wait}
Aghh! I can't stand it!\nMy feet burn with every\nstep I take!{end_wait}
I can't take another\nminute of this! Where\nis the oasis?{end_wait}
If we find no oasis\nsoon, I'll collapse\nout here!{end_wait}
